# Tatoeba example sentences (Japanese)

Example sentences with English translations from Tatoeba
(https://tatoeba.org), a collection of sentences and translations written by
its contributors.

- Licence: sentence text CC BY 2.0 FR
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/); sentences Tatoeba also
  releases under CC0 1.0 are marked "CC0 1.0" in credits.tsv. See LICENSE.
- Owners: credits.tsv lists every sentence of this pack with its Tatoeba id,
  page (https://tatoeba.org/en/sentences/show/<id>), licence and owner (the
  Tatoeba username listed for it), and the same for its English translation.
  Published copy: https://github.com/Elaktrato/qinqin/blob/main/plugins/data/ja-sentences-tatoeba/credits.tsv
- Readings: the "pinyin" field and the filing under words were generated from
  JMdict (https://www.edrdg.org/), by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG), CC BY-SA 4.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
- Source: Tatoeba's export of 2000-01-02 (https://downloads.example.invalid/exports/), files and SHA-256:
  - sentences_detailed.tar.bz2 (sentences_detailed.csv): bcaa4162d188a6b40572db084b44cc4cc0c76baa67ca09975aff1b3caee47b94
  - sentences_CC0.tar.bz2 (sentences_CC0.csv): 8424616fab038f976f7df24187ba5677313aa258f809321dd9e6ba503f373f53
  - links.csv.bz2 (links.csv): c0a45284ab7b2428728970706cbc2438a26f12389f17363f88d7346dee5139d2
  - tags.tar.bz2 (tags.csv): 061a3292ee2ad087464d232973b08ede1d95c50037ef7fd5a6bb13d3f4cf4709
  - user_languages.tar.bz2 (user_languages.csv): 0fe76cbc337a91c97067186a0d4557c21a8ec335379f743ffcecc78ca3c4a300
  - users_sentences.csv (users_sentences.csv): 6184b19a8e3f99e700eb05ce639c3ca8759691bc316dd220f45d5dac3e27df46
- Licence check: Tatoeba's downloads page and terms of use re-read on
  2000-01-03: Fixture: invented export, stated CC BY 2.0 FR with a CC0 subset.
- Changes: qinqin's tool server/tools/tatoeba selected the sentences with
  rules.json (SHA-256 2b0b7cdd912ffdb99a67e22ce86d4387e2247ded28979e633156dd7a528d012a): only sentences with an English
  translation; orphaned, flagged, negatively reviewed, deny-listed,
  near-duplicate and too short or long sentences dropped; native speakers
  preferred; at most 2 sentences per word. The readings were
  generated with JMdict-format fixture 1 and are left out where a word has several.
  The sentences are filed under the dictionary words they contain. The
  selection, the readings and the filing were made by a program and may
  contain errors.
- Contents: 6 sentences under 11 words.
